data.body: Completed read-only Verified-lane capacity research for dotted-uncheery-dunnart (2026-08-16). Current graph: docs-only=5 runner jobs; full route=17+N selected mutation shards, 0<=N<=7, maximum 24 allocations and maximum 19 simultaneously runnable jobs. Current live examples: 31900256967=17 jobs/65.6 runner-minutes; 31900214367=24 jobs/116.6 runner-minutes. Incident-period peak bucket (2026-08-13 20:30Z, seven runs 31741187649/31741458352/31741476017/31741500566/31741503429/31741506784/31741510115) reached 22 repository-local waiting jobs and a 14m33s maximum wait. Current-shape peak (2026-08-15 17:30Z, Gerrit 1813/1814/1815, runs 31898545665/31898595256/31898602868) again reached 22 waiting jobs; maximum runner wait was 3m17s. Current GitHub org API reports navapbc plan Free; public limits are 20 total / 5 macOS. Organization-wide historical queue and billing were not observable, so 22 is explicitly a lower bound. Decision brief recorded in full on the ticket: A recommended coverage-neutral scheduling reduction (bundle four short preflights plus mutation max-parallel=3: no-mutation 17->14, max 24->21, upper concurrent 19->12); B further same-change coalescing is low value because merged cancellation now costs only 107-127 runner-seconds and 78-110s per supersession; C moving macOS to six-hourly main health saves one scarce mac slot and about 9-11m in sampled runs but weakens pre-merge coverage; D Team plan raises total concurrency 20->60 but leaves macOS at 5 and has organization-wide cost. No workflow/code/external state changed. Ticket remains in_progress awaiting operator approval before any implementation plan or dispatch.
